name: Vigilante Sentai Soldier
body:
There are some vigilantes that strive to enhance their own powers, drawing from an internal power source that drives them forward. This power binds them to other sentai soldiers through an unknowable grid of power. Unlike others, they are tapped into their spirit, managing to form a bond between themselves and others which is unbreakable.

Elemental Spark (Su)

A sentai soldier is aware of the elements, able to bend them to their will. They gain the burn, elemental focus and kinetic blast feature of a kineticist, treating their sentai soldier level as their kineticist level for the purpose of their kinetic blast’s damage and saving throws, although they can only accept an amount of burn equal to their Constitution modifier (minimum 1) and don’t take nonlethal damage from accepting burn. This ability replaces vigilante specialization.

Morphing Transformation (Su)

A sentai soldier gains a morphing device which they use to enter their vigilante identity, unable to enter it without this morphing device. The sentai soldier’s morphing device must be an amulet, belt, gloves, or a ring. Using this morphing device requires the sentai soldier to somehow manipulate it, transforming into their vigilante identity in 5 rounds amid a burst of energy with the same visual and auditory display as the transformation sequence class feature of the magical child archetype. This is reduced to a standard action with the quick change social talent and an immediate action with the immediate change social talent. A sentai soldier can enhance their morphing device as though it were a bonded object.

If the sentai soldier’s morphing is lost or destroyed, they can replace it after 24 hours in a special ritual that costs 200 gp per sentai soldier level plus the cost of the masterwork item. This ritual takes 8 hours to complete. Items replaced in this way do not possess any of the additional enchantments of the previous morphing.

This ability alters dual identity.

Elemental Bond (Sp)

At 2nd level, a sentai soldier can select a utility or infusion wild talent in place of a vigilante talent, treating their sentai soldier level as their effective kineticist level. At 6th level, they also treat their sentai soldier level as their kineticist level for the purposes of selecting the Extra Wild Talent feat.

A sentai soldier can also select from any of the following vigilante talents, in addition to general vigilante talents:

Battle Charge (Su)

A sentai soldier can spend a swift action to reduce the burn cost of the kinetic blade or kinetic fist infusion by 1. This cannot reduce the burn cost of a blast lower than 0, and this burn reduction stacks with internal charge. A sentai soldier must possess either the kinetic blade or kinetic fist infusion to select this talent.

Battle Charge, Improved (Su)

A sentai soldier can use their battle charge with the kinetic whip infusion. In addition, their battle charge reduces the cost of a kinetic blast affected by kinetic blade, kinetic fist, or kinetic whip by 2 burn. This reduction increases to 3 at 18th level. This cannot reduce the burn cost of a blast lower than 0. The sentai soldier must by 10th level and possess battle charge to select this talent.

Composite Blaster (Sp)

A sentai soldier can combine their elements into a single blast, creating a more destructive attack than before. They gain access to any composite blast they would normally gain from expanding into their primary element (such as metal blast for earth). A sentai soldier must be 8th level or higher to select this talent.

Elemental Defense (Sp)

A sentai soldier gains the elemental defense for their elemental focus.

Empowered Blaster (Su)

A sentai soldier can channel even more power into their blast, beyond what they thought possible. They gain the metakinesis (empower) class feature. At 14th level, they also gain the metakinesis (quicken) class feature. A sentai soldier must be 6th level to select this talent.

Expanded Element (Su)

A sentai soldier understands more than just their own element, increasing their area of expertise into another. They gain the expanded element class feature, although they do not treat their kineticist level as 4 lower for the purpose of which wild talents the sentai soldier can select. A sentai soldier must be 8th level to select this talent.

Extreme Charge (Su)

A sentai soldier is more aware of how to channel their energy. Whenever they use their internal charge, they can spend a swift action to increase the amount of burn reduced with it by 1. A sentai soldier must be 10th level to select this talent.

Infusion Specialist (Su)

A sentai soldier gains the infusion specialist 1 class feature. At 16th level, this increases to infusion specialist 2. A sentai soldier must be 8th level or higher to select this talent.

The ability alters vigilante talent.

Powerful Transformation (Su)

At 3rd level, a sentai soldier gains the quick change social talent, and anyone who watches them transform must make a Will saving throw equal to 10 + 1/2 their sentai soldier level +their Charisma modifier or be fascinated for 1 minute. A sentai soldier must make a Disguise check if anyone witnessed their transformation with a -10 penalty (they can apply their seamless guise circumstance bonus to this check) to avoid exposing their true identity. This ability replaces unshakable.

Burning Power (Su)

At 4th level, a sentai soldier who has accepted 1 or more points of burn receives a bonus on their attack and damage rolls with kinetic blasts equal to the total number of points of burn they currently have, to a maximum bonus of +1 for every 4 sentai soldier levels they possess (treat this as the elemental overflow class feature for the purposes of how it interacts with infusions). Sentai soldiers benefiting from this class feature appear to glow in a color appropriate to their element, giving off light as a torch, and can suppress this effect as a full-round action, although doing so suppresses the benefits of this ability. This ability replaces A vigilante talents gained at 4th, 12th, and 20th level.

Internal Charge (Su)

At 5th level, a sentai soldier learns how to draw power from both themselves and their surroundings to empower their blast, power surging through them before releasing it in a torrent of elemental destruction. A vigilante gains the gather power class feature. At 10th level and every 4 levels thereafter, increase the amount of burn reduced with internal charge by 1. This ability replaces startling appearance, frightening appearance, and stunning appearance.

Dual Justice (Su)

At 20th level, all of a sentai soldier’s kinetic blast are empowered, and they gain access to the metakinesis (twice) class feature. This ability replaces vengeance strike.
